name: pankajanupam/quick-events-manager
description: Create events, publish them, and take free registrations. Start simple and switch on more features only when you need them.

extra.note: Nothing here is a runtime dependency. The shipped package contains no vendor directory: autoloading is a hand-written PSR-4 autoloader, and two plugins bundling different versions of one package is an unfixable class of WordPress conflict. See docs/adr/0007-no-runtime-dependencies.md.
extra.note-phpunit: PHPUnit is capped at 10.5 while PHP 7.4 is supported: PHPUnit 11 replaces @dataProvider with PHP 8 attributes. Chunk C0.3 raises the minimum to PHP 8.1 and removes this cap. See docs/adr/0002-php-and-wordpress-versions.md.

scripts.i18n: for po in languages/*.po; do msgfmt --check-format -o "${po%.po}.mo" "$po" || exit 1; done && echo 'Compiled all .po files.'

scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Fix what WordPress Coding Standards can fix automatically.
scripts-descriptions.lint:syntax: Parse every PHP file, proving the plugin loads on this PHP version.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI runs, in the order CI runs it.
